title: Qualify inbound leads
author: ana-torres
aboutParagraphs: A proven qualification system for real estate agencies using WhatsApp and AI.

Respond instantly, qualify every lead, and deliver sales-ready conversations to your team. Built for agencies that want faster response times, higher conversion rates, and a repeatable client service they can sell.

reviews.name: Priya Nair
reviews.text: Most clients asked prices in TikTok comments, but I couldn't reply fast enough. Chatfuel auto-replies with details and invites them to DM. I now book 3–4 new appointments every day straight from TikTok — amazing!

reviews.name: Mariana López
reviews.text: I used to miss half my DMs. Now every single message is answered instantly. The results? My chairs are full, and I don't even touch my phone.

update.messagePrompt: You are a real estate assistant. Greet the prospect warmly and ask which property or area they are interested in. Find out their budget, timeline, and whether they are buying or renting. If they are ready to move forward, let them know a team member will be in touch shortly. Be concise, professional, and friendly.
Follow up with leads who have not replied within 24 hours. Remind them that your team is available and invite them to share any questions or schedule a call.

rules.switchingConditions: The lead has confirmed their budget, timeline, and interest in a specific property or area and is ready to speak with an agent.
rules.messagePrompt: Great, I'm connecting you with one of our agents now. They will reach out to you shortly!
